responsibility: Analyzes uses of static variables confined to the current translation unit and propagates those effects over the callgraph. It records which functions and initializers read or write module statics, filters out address-taken cases, computes transitive read/write summaries, and streams the resulting IPA-reference bitmaps for LTO and later aliasing decisions.
same_name_distinction: Implements a distinct IPA pass over callgraph/varpool data to compute transitive read/write summaries for module-local static variables, using bitmaps and LTO streaming; unlike ipa-reference.h it is not just the query interface, and unlike ipa-ref.* it is not the generic symbol-reference list infrastructure.
